from delta.tables import DeltaTable
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, date_format 

# 1. Garantir que a database gold existe e definir o caminho de gravação
spark.sql("create database if not exists gold")
path_gold = "abfs://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/warehouse/4. GOLD"

# 2. Leitura da Silver de Armazém e Lookup da Dimensão Armazém
df_silver_wh = spark.table("silver.tb_wh")
dim_wh_lookup = spark.table("gold.dim_wh").select("sk_wh", "warehouse_id")

# 3. Construção da Tabela Fato
df_fct_wh_novos = (
    df_silver_wh
    # Join com a dimensão armazém para trazer a Surrogate Key (sk_wh)
    .join(dim_wh_lookup, on="warehouse_id", how="inner")
    .withColumn("sk_data", date_format(col("timestamp"),"yyyyMMdd").cast("int"))
    # Seleção final mantendo apenas as chaves (FKs), métricas e flags 
    .select(
       "sk_wh",
       "sk_data",
       "temperatura_celsius",
       "umidade",
       "timestamp",
      "status_temperatura",
      "status_umidade",
      "status_geral_armazem"
    )
)

caminho_fct = f"{path_gold}/fct_wh"
if not DeltaTable.isDeltaTable(spark, caminho_fct):
   
    (df_fct_wh_novos.write
            .format("delta")
            .option("path", f"{path_gold}/fct_wh")
            .saveAsTable("gold.fct_wh")

)
else:
   
    delta_fct_wh = DeltaTable.forPath(spark, caminho_fct)
    (
        delta_fct_wh.alias("fato")
        .merge(
            df_fct_wh_novos.alias("novos"),
            "fato.sk_wh = novos.sk_wh AND fato.timestamp = novos.timestamp"
        )
        .whenNotMatchedInsertAll()
        .execute()
    
    )
